$(bold)Nether:$() gold Y 10 to 40, ancient debris Y 8 to 22 (both as Geolosys deposits, both with samples).$(br2)Peat lies in swamps and burns. Granite, diorite and andesite come in plutons too, which is why a hillside is sometimes one stone.

$(bold)Processing:$() clusters smelt one to one. A $(bold)millstone$() crushes them (slow, iron-free). $(bold)Crushing wheels$() crush faster and $(bold)washing$() (encased fan over water) turns crushed ore into nuggets with a bonus.$(br2)Zinc clusters smelt straight to Create's zinc ingot: there is one zinc in this pack.
